title: Controller agent — moderator/judge Pydantic AI Agent that knows both sides, never reveals its stance, detects drift + nudges, renders a verdict, with the controller skills (Epic 5)
prompt:
Create the Controller as a Pydantic AI Agent. Prompt: it moderates/judges, knows both assigned sides, must NEVER reveal its own opinion or which side it leans, detects drift and nudges, and at the end renders a verdict. Give it the controller skills.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Third agent of Epic 5 (PRD §5.3 / anti-sycophancy §4). Added the CONTROLLER agent. prompts.py was already at 102 lines, so to stay under the 150-line limit the controller prompt text was put in its OWN module agents/controller_prompts.py (not appended to prompts.py): build_controller_system_prompt(*, pro_label='FOR', con_label='AGAINST', skills=CONTROLLER_SKILLS) plus named constants CONTROLLER_SKILLS=('assess_drift','nudge','render_verdict'), CONTROLLER_SKILL_USAGE, ROLE_LINE, SIDES_LINE, NEUTRALITY_TEMPLATE (NEVER reveal own stance/opinion or which side it leans; you hold no stance; verdict is debate-derived not personal), MODERATION_TEMPLATE (detect drift; nudge privately — a private correction that does NOT count as a debate turn; render a verdict at the end), and the skill-list block (each named skill + one-line when-to-use). The factory create_controller(settings=None, *, model=None) -> pydantic_ai.Agent lives in agents/controller.py, mirroring the debater factory: resolves CONTROLLER_MODEL via resolve_model (Settings.controller_model, default anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 — no hard-coded value) or uses an injected model, logs via LOG (get_logger('agents') -> controller_created event). Re-exported create_controller + build_controller_system_prompt + CONTROLLER_SKILLS from agent_debate.core.agents and agent_debate.core. API gatekeeper (Epic 13): N/A — the factory only constructs Agent/model objects offline, no external call. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_controller_agent.py (12 tests), watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'CONTROLLER_SKILLS'), then implemented to green. Tests use an injected pydantic-ai TestModel (no network, no API key) and assert the prompt moderates+judges, knows both sides (FOR+AGAINST), contains an explicit 'never reveal' stance/opinion instruction, does NOT leak a pre-held stance (no 'I think Pro/Con is right', 'I lean', etc.), mentions drift detection + private nudge ('does not count' / 'not a debate turn') + verdict, lists all three controller skill names, and that create_controller(model=TestModel()) returns a pydantic_ai.Agent carrying that system prompt; one test sets dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + CONTROLLER_MODEL to cover the no-injected-model offline resolve path (AnthropicModel). Gates green locally (see PR CI for authoritative result).
